srs.status_learning.note: 'Am Lernen' implies currently in progress; 'Sedang Belajar' better mirrors the progressive aspect.

statistics.activity_aria.note: Accurate and clear translation of the aria label.

statistics.activity_cell.note: Both placeholders {count} and {date} preserved; phrasing is natural.

statistics.activity_title.note: Aktivitas (90 hari terakhir) accurately conveys Aktivität (letzte 90 Tage).

statistics.avg_accuracy.note: Akurasi rata-rata accurately conveys Durchschnittliche Genauigkeit.

statistics.completed_lessons.note: Pelajaran selesai is acceptable; Pelajaran yang diselesaikan is more precise but this is fine.

statistics.errors.note: kesalahan is correct but should be capitalised (Kesalahan) to match UI label convention.

statistics.last_answer.note: Jawaban terakhirmu: accurately conveys Deine letzte Antwort: with appropriate informal register.

statistics.pair_level_aria.note: Both placeholders {level} and {percent} preserved; translation is accurate.

statistics.pairs_title.note: Kemajuan menurut pasangan bahasa accurately conveys Fortschritt pro Sprachpaar.

statistics.practice.note: Latih is a correct imperative form matching Üben.

statistics.time_hm.note: Placeholders preserved. Abbreviations {h}j {m}mnt are compact but uncommon; {h} jam {m} mnt would be clearer.

statistics.time_m.note: Placeholder preserved. {m}mnt lacks a space; {m} mnt is more readable.

statistics.weak_areas_title.note: Area untuk ditingkatkan accurately conveys Bereiche zum Verbessern.

subjects.basics.note: 'Dasar' is acceptable but 'Dasar-dasar' or 'Dasar' is fine; slightly terse for a subject label.

subjects.calculus.note: German 'Analysis' maps to 'Kalkulus' in ID context; acceptable common usage.

subjects.chinese.note: 'Mandarin' is a specific dialect, while 'Chinesisch' is broader Chinese. Acceptable if Mandarin is intended, but inconsistent naming style vs other languages.

subjects.english.note: 'Inggris' typically refers to England/British; the language is 'Bahasa Inggris'. In a subject list context 'Inggris' alone may be ambiguous.

subjects.frameworks.note: 'Kerangka kerja' is a valid translation but inconsistent capitalisation (two words, lowercase second).

subjects.french.note: 'Prancis' refers to France; language should be 'Bahasa Prancis' for consistency.

subjects.german.note: 'Jerman' refers to Germany; language should be 'Bahasa Jerman' for consistency.

subjects.greek.note: 'Yunani' refers to Greece; language should be 'Bahasa Yunani' for consistency.

subjects.italian.note: 'Italia' refers to Italy; language should be 'Bahasa Italia' for consistency.

subjects.japanese.note: 'Jepang' refers to Japan; language should be 'Bahasa Jepang' for consistency.

subjects.languages.note: 'Bahasa' means 'language' (singular); plural or general concept is better as 'Bahasa-bahasa' or idiomatically just 'Bahasa' is acceptable in Indonesian.

subjects.portuguese.note: 'Portugis' refers to Portugal/Portuguese people; language should be 'Bahasa Portugis' for consistency.

subjects.public_speaking.note: German 'Rhetorik' maps broadly; 'Berbicara di Depan Umum' is an acceptable functional equivalent for this context.

subjects.spanish.note: 'Spanyol' refers to Spain/Spanish people; language should be 'Bahasa Spanyol' for consistency in a subject list.

subjects.turkish.note: 'Turki' refers to Turkey; language should be 'Bahasa Turki' for consistency.

sync.camera_error_hint.note: DE says 'nutze den Einfüge-Modus' (paste mode); ID renders it as 'tempel-tautan' (paste-link) which adds specificity not in source.
sync.camera_error_hint.suggestion: Ada yang salah saat memulai kamera. Coba lagi, atau gunakan mode tempel.

sync.conflicts_intro.note: DE uses 'Eintrag' (entry/item); ID uses 'catatan' (note/record) which is acceptable but slightly imprecise.
sync.conflicts_intro.suggestion: Kedua perangkat mengubah entri yang sama sejak sinkronisasi terakhir. Pilih versi mana yang dipertahankan untuk masing-masing.

sync.intro.note: German uses imperative 'klicke auf …'; ID rephrases as indicative 'Anda mengeklik'. Minor tone inconsistency; also missing quotes around button name.
sync.intro.suggestion: Pasangkan ponsel dan desktop di jaringan lokal yang sama. Sinkronisasi selalu opsional; klik 'Sinkronkan Sekarang' saat ingin menggabungkan perubahan.

sync.merge_editor.note: 'Eintrag' means 'entry/record', not 'catatan' (note). 'Entri gabungan' would be more precise.

sync.no_camera_hint.note: 'Einfüge-Modus' (paste mode) is translated as 'opsi tempel-tautan' (paste-link option), adding 'tautan' not in source.
sync.no_camera_hint.suggestion: Perangkat ini tidak memiliki kamera. Gunakan mode tempel sebagai gantinya.

sync.phone_hint_v17.note: German says 'im Sync-Bereich der Desktop-App'; ID says 'layar Pengaturan > Sinkronisasi desktop Anda', adding 'Pengaturan >' not present in source.
sync.phone_hint_v17.suggestion: Pindai kode QR di area Sinkronisasi aplikasi desktop Anda. Kamera belakang ponsel membaca tautan pemasangan secara otomatis.

sync.scan_hint.note: German order is 'Einstellungen > Sync' on phone; ID renders as 'Pengaturan > Sinkronisasi ponsel' swapping 'ponsel' position slightly but acceptable. Overall meaning preserved.
sync.scan_hint.suggestion: Buka Pengaturan > Sinkronisasi di ponsel, tempel tautan ini, dan ketuk Hubungkan. Tautan kedaluwarsa dalam 5 menit dan hanya dapat digunakan sekali.

sync.unpair.note: Slightly verbose; 'Putuskan pasangan' or 'Lepas pasangan' is more concise and idiomatic for a UI button label.

sync.unpair_confirm.note: Source uses 'du' (informal) throughout the app but translation switches to 'Anda' (formal). Tone inconsistency with other strings.
sync.unpair_confirm.suggestion: Lepaskan pasangan perangkat ini? Data lokal dipertahankan; sinkronisasi mendatang diblokir hingga kamu memasangkan lagi.

taxonomy.clear_filters.note: 'Hapus saringan' is acceptable; 'saringan' is a valid informal term for filter in Indonesian.

taxonomy.tags.note: 'Tag' is acceptable but plural form 'Tag-tag' or 'Tag' is fine; however 'Schlagwörter' implies plural, consider 'Tag' is fine in Indonesian as it is invariable.

ui.a11y.chart_radar_value.note: 'Wert' means value; 'Skor' means score, slight meaning drift

ui.error_report.dialog_title.note: DE says 'Fehler melden' (report an error/bug); 'Laporkan masalah' says 'report a problem' — slightly imprecise but acceptable in context.

ui.error_report.intro_proactive.note: DE says 'für die Entwicklung' (for development/the dev team); ID renders as 'untuk dikirim ke pengembang' (to be sent to developer) adding detail not in source.
ui.error_report.intro_proactive.suggestion: Siapkan laporan tindakan terbaru Anda untuk pengembang. Anda dapat melihat dengan tepat isinya sebelum apa pun meninggalkan peramban Anda.

ui.error_report.offline.note: 'Luring' is the formal Indonesian term for 'offline' but may be unfamiliar; 'offline' is the common term used in Indonesian UI contexts.

ui.error_report.online.note: 'Daring' is the formal Indonesian term for 'online' but may be unfamiliar to many users; 'online' is widely understood and commonly used in Indonesian UI.

ui.errors.forbidden.note: German uses informal 'deine'; ID uses formal 'Anda'. App tone should be consistent; if app uses informal, change to 'kamu'.
ui.errors.forbidden.suggestion: Akses ditolak. Silakan periksa pengaturan kamu.

ui.help.no_results.note: 'Treffer' means hits/matches; 'entri yang cocok' (entries that match) is slightly over-specific. 'Tidak ada hasil.' is more natural.

ui.help.open_help.note: Source uses informal 'oeffnen' (ASCII); translation is correct.

ui.tooltips.chat_language.note: German 'die du sprichst' uses informal 'du'; translation uses formal 'Anda'. Tone inconsistency if app uses informal elsewhere.

ui.tooltips.edit.note: 'Edit' is widely accepted in Indonesian UI contexts.

ui.tooltips.rate_session.note: Slightly expanded but conveys the same meaning idiomatically.

ui.tooltips.refresh.note: 'Segarkan' is acceptable; 'Muat ulang' is also common but not wrong.

voice.mic_network.note: Mixing formal 'Anda' with otherwise informal tone; also 'sedang offline' is fine but 'tidak tersedia' sounds more natural.
voice.mic_network.suggestion: Pengenalan suara tidak tersedia secara offline. Periksa koneksi internetmu.

voice.mic_no_device.note: 'Tidak ada mikrofon ditemukan' is awkward; more natural: 'Mikrofon tidak ditemukan.'
voice.mic_no_device.suggestion: Mikrofon tidak ditemukan. Sambungkan mikrofon dan coba lagi.

voice.speak.note: 'Bacakan dengan keras' is overly verbose for a UI button; 'Bacakan' or 'Baca keras' is more idiomatic.

voice.stop_listening.note: Source is 'Diktat stoppen' (stop dictation); 'Berhenti mendengarkan' means 'stop listening', drifting from dictation context.

voice.stop_speaking.note: German is simply 'Stopp'; 'Hentikan pembacaan' is accurate but verbose. A short 'Berhenti' or 'Stop' matches the terse source better.
